Daily!. Every day my wife and I have been reading Today in the Word for years!Every day for years my parents have been reading it. My accountability partner and his wife also. I encourage people at church to read it daily. I even give the link to unbelievers with whom I’ve shared the gospel. Every human on the planet should be involved in this daily journey!!!

Consistent, Reliable, Worthy. This morning I opened my Today In The Word app as usual. It is a habit I treasure … starting my day in His word thru these devotionals. 
The monthly themes hold my interest and build understanding of scriptures, some familiar to me and others not so. The teachings on each day’s readings bless me, and frequently I verbally thank the authors, though they never hear me. 
Each day’s reading is consistent with the purpose of exposing readers to God’s words, and the expository writings reliably teach their themes and purposes.
A cup of coffee and Today In the Word is my morning routine- a habit worthy of my time before diving into the day. I share paper copies with my friend, so know she is learning too through this ministry. 
Thank you to all who make this possible. You bless me.

reviews.text: Changed from paper to digital.. I really like the TW Devotional app. I used to study from the TW paper form, but the fonts used began to look smaller and I found it hard to read. The app is very convenient and has good tools. It does have a couple of cons that I would like to see improved. One thing to fix is The bible verse that is on the picture image is hard to read. The color contrast between the letters against the picture/image makes it hard to see and read. Also, it would be nice to read the bible in dark mode. It’s interesting that when you click on the verse link to read it shows as a nice eye soothing darkened color, but when you want to read the whole chapter in the bible part of app it only shows with the white background. I hope these two things can be updated in next app update. Thank you.

Back To Basics. My devotional life at 68 was waning. Retirement, 3 years ago was a shock I was unprepared for. As a man, I defined myself by what I did. Now I was like a lost child! Part of my “settling “ was reminiscing in the past. I recalled receiving in the mail: Today in The Word from Moody Bible Institute. Each month was a study of a book of the Bible. I grew so much in my faith with this process! But at some point I was distracted by “fluff” devotional booklet’s. Recently I stumbled on Today in The Word , on line. I signed up and have been receiving them daily, restoring my relationship with Old Friends…I say Friends because becoming re familiar with Today in The Word has re ignited my relationship with The Trinity thru THE WORD. Thanks for the blessings, the familiar blessing!

Great app - minor hitch with Bible passage references. * Addendum to original review to suggest ability to change Bible versions within the scripture reading page like on the web version *

Great app. Like the fact that one doesn’t need to go into email (and potentially get distracted first thing in the morning). Clean layout and of course good content. Content alone warrants 5 stars (so this overall really should be 4.5 stars). 

 One minor improvement to suggest to bring it a 5: add the scripture reference in the scripture reading section. As it stands now- you see the text reference at the top of the day’s devotional page, but when you click in to read the passage, the actual Bible reference information is gone I often have to click back out and then click in to see where the passage is from. It should be in the body of text somewhere (also helps with memorization). Currently the Bible text just has a body of text with no associated Bible references.

* Update/addition to original review: In the web version the passage of the day is conveniently displayed with the ability to change to any Bible version. In the app, only the default version is shown and one has to go into a separate Bible tab to change versions, but it then shows the entire chapter so locating the day’s passage (especially if you are comparing several different versions) can be troublesome. It would be great if one is able to change versions on the main passage of the day page without requiring to link out to separate tab and trying to find the passage within a much larger chapter text each time. *

Gray font on white background?. The devotional itself is excellent. For reading, however, gray ink on a white background is not so good. Each day it’s written in such a way that is not only full of wisdom and truth that I feel God is directly guiding me, but I learn so much about how those in the Bible who have come before us have lived. Their problems, doubts and worries have come alive to me. And isn’t that what it’s all about? We Christians sometimes think we are unique in what we face in this world, these times and situations are too different from biblical times. But, even as our Lord has knitted us to be unique, the problems we face as humans are no different, just the time in history. Today in the Word shines a light, God’s light and wisdom for all of us. Thank you Moody Bible Institute that your writers seek God’s spirit each day before they sit down and write these. What wisdom, insight, strength and encouragement we are provided with each day. May God continue to bless the work they have been entrusted to do.
